create_ClapProcessor: create a ClapProcessor instance with a feature_extractor and tokenizer for audio-text processing
build_ClapProcessor_from_pretrained: build a ClapProcessor from a pretrained model checkpoint using from_pretrained with model id
test_ClapProcessor_call: test the ClapProcessor __call__ method to process audio inputs and text inputs into model-ready tensors
save_ClapProcessor_to_directory: save a ClapProcessor instance to a local directory using save_pretrained with optional push_to_hub
summarize_ClapProcessor_post_process: summarize the ClapProcessor post_process_multimodal_output method to decode generated model outputs
